name: Vought F4U Corsair
summary: Carrier-based WWII fighter with a huge Pratt & Whitney R-2800 radial and a distinctive inverted gull wing; one of the best-known US Navy and Marine fighters, and a favorite at air shows.

wings: Inverted gull wing: bent downward at the root and then outward
Wide, square-tipped wing that folds for carrier storage
engines: Huge R-2800 radial in a big round cowl
Long nose that hides the cockpit's forward view
fuselage: Cockpit set far back on a long fuselage
Bubble canopy on the F4U-1D/FG-1D, framed 'birdcage' on early ones
Retractable tailwheel with an arrestor hook
tail: Tall fin with a large rudder
Horizontal tail mounted on the fuselage with a sharp-cornered shape

tellTales: Inverted gull wings: down at the root, up at the tip
Huge round radial nose with the cockpit set far behind it
Long nose, short legs and a sharp tail of a carrier fighter

confusedWith.howToTell: The Bearcat is smaller and stubby with a straight low wing and a tall fin; the Corsair has the distinctive inverted gull wing and a much longer nose.
The Wildcat is a short, chubby mid-wing fighter with straight wings; the Corsair has bent gull wings and a longer nose.
The Thunderbolt has a straight low wing, an oval chin intake and a deep belly; the Corsair has bent gull wings and a long nose.
The Sea Fury has a long straight wing and a slim fuselage with a five-blade prop; the Corsair has bent gull wings.
